genius.notes: DAI is a protocol stablecoin generated against collateral through CDP vaults and the LitePSM; there is no legal PPSI issuer entity. Whether DAI qualifies as a payment stablecoin under the GENIUS Act definition remains structurally unclear. No PPSI application, state-qualified approval, or issuer-announced intent found as of June 2026. GENIUS rulemaking remains in proposed-rules phase (no final rules, no approvals).
